purpose: Apply the current-default training-OOF margin policy and its fixed abstention cutoff to canonical Test1 and Test2 predictions without test-specific recalibration, quantile selection, or coverage forcing.

frozen_policy_contract.score_interpretation: Direct normalized proximity to the frozen decision boundary; label-independent and not a calibrated sample-level error probability.

selection_firewall.selection_procedure: Compute normalized decision_closeness independently for each sample, then compare it with the immutable OOF-derived cutoff.
prohibited_selection_inputs: Test1/Test2 sample count or class prevalence
selection_firewall.coverage_rule: Realized coverage is reported after fixed-cutoff application and is never forced to 90% on either test split.

validation_guards.pre_outcome_protocol_amendment: Canonical prediction CSVs serialize the unchanged binary threshold to 10 decimal places (0.4702225653); allow only this bounded representation difference. This amendment was made after a label-blind guard failure and before labels or selective outcomes were read.

random_rejection_control.definition: Uniformly choose exactly the realized frozen-threshold accepted count from each complete test split.
random_rejection_control.summary: mean, median, 2.5th percentile, and 97.5th percentile across random masks

paired_bootstrap.sampling: Within each test split, resample original sample indices within true label with replacement while retaining the original class counts.
paired_bootstrap.fixed_mask_application: The immutable original-sample acceptance mask is indexed onto each resampled position; it is never recalculated from bootstrap quantiles.
paired_bootstrap.random_control_within_each_replicate: Uniformly accept the same number of resampled positions as the frozen threshold accepts in that replicate.
paired_bootstrap.multiple_comparison_policy: Report effect sizes and percentile intervals without p-values or significance stars.

per_split_strong_support: frozen-threshold accepted-error point estimate is below both full-cohort error and the equal-count random-rejection mean
the 95% paired-bootstrap lower bound for full-minus-frozen accepted error is above zero
interpretation_rule.per_split_descriptive_support: The error point estimate is below both comparators, but the paired interval includes zero.
interpretation_rule.per_split_not_supported: The frozen-threshold accepted-error point estimate is not below both comparators.
interpretation_rule.overall_strong_support: Both Test1 and Test2 satisfy per-split strong support.
interpretation_rule.overall_consistent_descriptive_support: Both splits improve relative to both comparators, but at least one split lacks a strictly positive paired lower interval.
interpretation_rule.overall_mixed_or_not_supported: At least one split fails the point-estimate criterion.

panels.A: Realized Test1/Test2 coverage under the unchanged OOF-derived cutoff, with the 90% OOF target shown only as a reference.
panels.B: Accepted error for the full predictor, frozen-threshold accepted set, and equal-count random rejection.
panels.C: MCC for the same three methods.
